_comment: Hearthbound: BWG coverage for mvs:is_mushroom, which MoogsVoyagerStructures-1.20-5.0.8.jar ships as an explicit biome list (terralith/biomesoplenty/byg/RU named one by one), so BWG generated none of these structures.
